evidence_schema.description: A gate may be passed only with actual, dated evidence applying to the exact store, theme, commit, SKU, provider or DNS zone. A template is not evidence.

fields.type: Non-sensitive evidence category, such as cli_output, admin_record, legal_record, supplier_record, test_result, owner_approval or dns_query.
fields.observed_at: ISO 8601 date-time with timezone, or a date when the source supplies only a date.
fields.summary: Concise factual result without credentials or personal/payment/customer data.
fields.reference: Repository-relative path or redacted controlled-record identifier.
fields.operator_or_source: Non-sensitive operator role or authoritative source.
fields.scope: Exact store, theme ID, commit, SKU, provider, test order or DNS records covered.
fields.limitations: Known limits, expiry, conditions or reasons the evidence does not pass the gate.
